notes.meaning: God announces a coming day of judgment that will burn like a blazing furnace. The proud and evil, who once seemed to prosper, will be consumed like dry straw. The fire will leave them neither root nor branch, showing that their ruin is total and they will never sprout again.

For those who honor God, a bright sun will rise, bringing righteousness and healing in its rays. Christians have long recognized this Sun as Jesus Christ, who brings spiritual life and forgives sins. God's people will rejoice with boundless energy, leaping like young calves let out of a stall into a green pasture.

differ.view: Some evangelicals see the sun of righteousness as a symbol for the future era of blessing, rather than a personal title for Jesus Christ.

other.label: Modern scholarship
other.view: Many modern scholars understand the winged sun as a familiar ancient Near Eastern symbol for divine justice and restoration, rather than a prophecy about an individual person.

notes.meaning: When God finishes His work of judgment, the righteous will walk over the defeated wicked like ashes on the ground. The people who once suffered under evil rulers will finally share in the Lord's complete victory. God's people can trust that justice will truly be done in the end.

God commands Israel to remember and obey the teachings He gave through Moses at Mount Sinai, which is also called Horeb. Because no new prophets would speak for the next four hundred years, the people needed to hold tightly to the written scriptures they already had. Faithful obedience to God's word was their guide while they waited for the Messiah.

The Lord promises to send a prophet like Elijah before that great and dreadful day of judgment arrives. The New Testament reveals that John the Baptist fulfilled this promise by preaching with the bold spirit and power of Elijah to prepare people for Jesus.

differ.view: Some evangelicals believe John the Baptist was only a partial fulfillment, and that an Elijah-like prophet will still appear before Christ's second coming.

notes.meaning: This messenger will lead people to turn back to God, healing divisions between parents and children and restoring the faith of their godly ancestors. If the nation refuses to repent, God warns that He will strike the land with a curse of complete destruction. The Old Testament ends with this urgent warning, pointing to our deep need for the Savior.
